title: James Fox's attempt to get the Vandenberg film through Congress

tellings.quote: So she told James Fox about it and then James Fox said really? So then he went and he contacted Ellen Sandler and then Ellen said, "If you if you want it, it's 25,000 bucks to use in your your documentary."

plain: A film said to come from Vandenberg, an Air Force base in California, was offered to the documentary filmmaker James Fox for $25,000, after a woman named Angela Joiner told him about it, and Fox then tried to get it seen through Congress. The researcher Grant Cameron tells this second-hand, saying Fox contacted Allan Sandler, a filmmaker who worked with Bob Emenegger, who said, "it's 25,000 bucks to use in your documentary." If the film is what is claimed, it would be official footage of something unexplained.
